_comment: Each entry is an ElevenLabs webhook tool_config (POST /v1/convai/tools takes {"tool_config": <entry>}). Replace <ENGINE_HOST> with the engine's public HTTPS host. Setup steps: voice/setup.md.

tools.name: request_approval
tools.description: Ask the traveler to approve an extra cost (a fee or a change) before agreeing to it. Returns an approval_id and a status; if the status is pending, call check_approval with that approval_id.

tools.name: check_approval
tools.description: Check whether the traveler approved. Each check waits several seconds for an answer. Status is pending, approved, rejected or denied.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Call exactly once, right before ending the call, after repeating back what was agreed. Report only what the clerk actually said. Leave door_code out if the clerk did not give one or took it back.

held.description: True only if the clerk agreed to hold the room tonight

fee_usd.description: Extra fee agreed on the call in US dollars, 0 if none

door_code.description: Door or key-box code exactly as the clerk said it

contact.description: First name of the person the guest should ask for
